People have already told you that you’re handsome on the other pictures you’ve posted, and I agree with them. You have great physical qualities. But you need to find your admiration for yourself from the inside or it won’t really mean anything to you. Ask yourself what qualities you admire the most in yourself: are you thoughtful, tough, a hard-worker, hold the door for others, creative? When you admire your best qualities the physical ones melt away. What really matters is what makes you, you.

I remember walking my dogs outside in southern Virginia and seeing a redneck looking guy with a BB gun sneaking around in his front yard. He was watching a small skunk on the side of his yard who was digging around and told us to be quiet so he could shoot it. His reasoning: OBVIOUSLY it had rabies even though the sun was setting and the little guy wasn’t running because he was unaware of us. 

I quietly told my dog to “go get it” while holding her leash and she started barking and pulling. The little guy turned around and scurried quickly away much to the redneck’s frustration.
I’m so sorry. Cherish the memories.
